name: Hsienyang (Gleaves class)
configuration: Approved GameModels3D Hsienyang Hull A; source-model fit, exact historical refit unverified

provenance.note: Original Fletcher-derived enclosure adjusted for the approved Hsienyang Mk30 mod0 source-model proportions. Geometry is independently authored; model fit under visual review, not a historical certification.

ballistics.basis: Estimated linear drag from projectile mass, bore area, muzzle speed, air density 1.225 kg/m3 and Cd 0.25; penetration budget referenced at 5000 m. Shared game approximation; no historical firing-table or Mach-curve claim. See assets/parts/author-plausible-ballistics.ts.

Provisional game calibration, not historical firing data. Linear k=0.5*1.225*0.25*area*muzzleSpeed/mass; no Mach curve. Angular/speed sigmas are estimated, capped at 3 sigma; no salvo correlation or rangefinder error. Legacy penetrationMm retained at 1000 m, 10 m launch/sea target, nominal speed (508.570 m/s); see assets/parts/calibrate-penetration.ts. Residual budget follows speed^1.4, including descent recovery; armor resistance paid separately.

he.basis: Provisional HE game calibration, not historical shell/stock data. Contact burst; fill 8% of nominal projectile mass, fragment budget caliber/6 in mm, burst damage twice the AP catalog value. 40% HE stock rounded down per barrel. Shares the gun nominal launch mass/speed/drag envelope as an approximation. See assets/parts/author-he.ts.

accuracy.exterior: Original geometry targeting user-approved GameModels3D Hsienyang A. In-progress visual review. Exact refit date unverified.
accuracy.internals: Provisional compartments and machinery envelopes, not surveyed subdivisions.
accuracy.weapons: Source-model fit; performance, ammunition and fire control are game conventions.

structures.name: Lower bridge with rounded aft corners
Forward machinery casing and torpedo deck
After gun deck and AA overhang

structuralPlating.note: Provisional steel plating for gameplay, not surveyed armor.

localDamage.basis: Original game calibration: eight longitudinal sections, independent sides and three height bands, with separate gunhouse budgets. Generator/director proxy positions and fire loads are estimated; no historical structural tolerance, electrical routing, ventilation or crew-performance claim.

damageControl.basis: Provisional game calibration shared across presets: three abstract teams, six-second setup, finite normalized fuel and spares. Repairs stop at 60% and cannot revive destroyed equipment. Small-hole shoring and portable pumps require accessible spaces. Flash-path attenuation is estimated; no individual crew, ventilation or electrical network.

propulsion.basis: Provisional game assignment of two equally weighted boiler/turbine trains; exact machinery interconnections are not established by the approved exterior reference.

stability.basis: Estimated loading: dry CG calibrated to an initial GM of 7% beam; longitudinal CG matches modeled buoyancy at reference waterline. Uniform buoyancy scale reconciles stated mass with the authored hull volume. Outer shell uses the blueprint structural plating thickness. Residual flood cells conservatively exclude retained room boxes; partitions, permeability and access are game estimates.
